children: ICICI Securities research report on InterGlobe Aviation

Crude prices (ATF) have been higher for longer now, with an impact likely in Q2FY27 extending into Q3 (basis Aug’27 trend). As such, there is a downgrade in our earnings estimates for FY27. However, that does not change our thesis on IndiGo, and we believe that this correction could be a buying opportunity. At this juncture, the industry has consolidated, travel demand is high (>20% yield hike in Q1 and 25% yield hike guidance in Q2 is noteworthy validation to that end), and with stable currency incrementally, we also expect non-fuel CASK to stabilise hereon at an annual level. IndiGo’s 2030 outlook, wherein it may have an annual capacity of ~300bn ASKs, implying mid-teens capacity CAGR, 200mn passengers and >3,000 daily departures by 2030, also improves medium-term earnings visibility and in turn provides constructive valuation guidance for investors.

We maintain BUY with an unchanged target price of INR 6,020, based on 25x (unchanged) FY28E EPS of INR 241 (post-full tax). Key risks: A volatile geopolitical environment or business disruptions akin to those in FY26. However, its strong competitive position hedges that risk significantly, as already demonstrated multiple times.
